scaffold.mobile-ios: Create the project in Xcode (File > New > Project), then continue

requires.mobile-expo: Xcode (iOS simulator) or Android Studio emulator; Maestro CLI: brew tap mobile-dev-inc/tap && brew install mobile-dev-inc/tap/maestro (needs Java 17+)
requires.mobile-ios: Xcode 27+ (the xcode plugin needs it); install it from your own terminal if in-session install refuses

mcp.maestro: claude mcp add --scope project maestro -- maestro mcp

goal: /goal bash scripts/verify.sh exits 0 with output shown and maestro test .maestro/ passes, or stop after 20 turns
